findings.requirement: Multi-table dependency invalidation must be safe and selective
findings.evidence: A shared row trigger referenced fields absent from some trigger tables during clean replay.
findings.rectification: Split invalidation into journey, fact, symptom, medication and evidence table-specific trigger functions with bounded dependency lookup.

findings.requirement: Existing plans and reviews must bind authenticated owner and current journey truth
findings.evidence: New required owner/journey columns made an accepted Stage 2 fixture insert invalid.
findings.rectification: Added database-derived owner/journey binding triggers and retained strict foreign keys.

findings.requirement: Refresh and relogin must reload durable truth
findings.evidence: The initial UI integration exposed only an authenticated version snapshot, not committed fact/plan/task/review records.
findings.rectification: Added owner-only stage10_durable_state RPC, authenticated client method and UI reload on every authenticated render.

findings.requirement: User edits must pass the accepted Stage 8 validation boundary
findings.evidence: Plan user_edits initially accepted untyped dictionaries.
findings.rectification: Added strict ValidatedPlanEdit schema, trace requirement, item/field matching and equivalent transactional SQL enforcement.

findings.requirement: A plan cannot omit active confirmed hard constraints
findings.evidence: A syntactically valid plan could omit a confirmed allergy dependency.
findings.rectification: The in-memory and SQL committers now require dependencies for every active confirmed allergy, restriction and clinician instruction.

findings.requirement: Corrections must invalidate dependencies on superseded truth
findings.evidence: A correction invalidated only the new material key and could leave a plan linked to the superseded fact active.
findings.rectification: Correction commits now invalidate the old fact identity/material dependency and the new confirmed dependency atomically.

findings.requirement: Only the State Committer may mutate confirmed facts and plans
findings.evidence: Earlier authenticated direct CRUD grants remained on health_facts, plans, plan_items and human_review_cases.
findings.rectification: Stage 10 migration replaces authenticated manage policies with owner-read policies and revokes direct INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE while granting only the commit RPC.

findings.requirement: Offline UI checks must show recoverable unavailability
findings.evidence: Stage 4 UI smoke reproduced an uncaught URLError from durable-state loading.
findings.rectification: The client converts network/timeout/OS failures into a typed RuntimeError; the UI renders an honest unavailable state. Focused regression and Stage 4 UI smoke pass.

findings.requirement: Migration SQL must compile on clean and upgrade histories
findings.evidence: Clean pgTAP exposed an ambiguous JSON dependency alias inside PL/pgSQL.
findings.rectification: Renamed the SQL alias and replayed both clean and exact Stage 9-to-10 migrations successfully.

findings.requirement: All earlier pgTAP regressions must remain meaningful and green
findings.evidence: stage2_security_and_lifecycle.test.sql expects authenticated direct CRUD policies for four tables; Stage 10 requires those exact writes to be denied and routed through stage10_commit. The Stage 10 security assertions pass 38/38, but the legacy file stops after 32/122 assertions.
findings.rectification: No test expectation was changed without explicit approval. The production contract remains fail-closed.
